author: Rahul kp
title: Bonus Shares
simple_words: Bonus shares are free, paid from reserves. Rights shares are offered to existing holders, who pay for them.

definitions.meaning: Fully paid shares given free to existing shareholders in proportion to holding, by capitalising reserves.
Offer of new shares to existing shareholders in proportion to holding, at a stated price. The holder may accept or renounce.

key_points: Bonus: ==reserves convert into share capital==; no cash is received.
Rights: company ==raises fresh funds== from existing members.
Both go to existing shareholders in the same ratio as their holding.
!!Revaluation reserve cannot be used for bonus shares!!.

entries.label: Bonus issue (fully paid)
entries.narration: Being bonus shares issued out of free reserves

entries.label: Rights issue (at a premium)
entries.narration: Being rights shares issued and money received

insight.text: Bonus only moves money inside equity; rights bring new money into the company.
insight.punchline: Bonus: no cash. Rights: cash in!

trick_hook: B for Book, R for Rupees

memory_trick.explanation: Bonus is only a book transfer from reserves to capital. Rights bring Rupees into the Bank, so the Bank A/c is debited.

exam_tip: In bonus-source MCQs, pick the reserve that is not free or not a premium or capital redemption reserve: revaluation reserve.

doubt.question: Does a bonus issue increase total shareholders' funds?
doubt.answer: No. Reserves fall and share capital rises by the same amount, so total equity stays the same. A rights issue increases it.

mistakes.wrong: Debiting Bank A/c when bonus shares are issued
mistakes.right: Bonus brings no cash. Debit the reserve used and credit Equity Share Capital.

mistakes.wrong: Using revaluation reserve to issue bonus shares
mistakes.right: Use free reserves, securities premium or capital redemption reserve. Revaluation reserve is not allowed.

mistakes.wrong: Saying rights shares must be taken up by every holder
mistakes.right: A rights offer can be accepted or renounced; the holder is not forced.

Checker 1: Exam tip: the phrase 'pick the reserve that is not free or not a premium or capital redemption reserve' is garbled. Read literally, almost any reserve is 'not free or not a premium'. Correct version: 'In bonus-source MCQs, Section 63 allows only free reserves, securities premium account and capital redemption reserve account. So pick the reserve that is none of these: revaluation reserve.'
